output.summary: A genus of slow-growing, potentially very long-lived coniferous trees and shrubs occurring across temperate parts of the Northern Hemisphere, with some populations in tropical highlands. Their single seeds sit partly inside bright red, berry-like arils. The sweet aril is edible, but its seed and every other part contain dangerous poisons and may be fatal if eaten.
output.edibilityNote: The sweet aril is edible only after its dangerously poisonous seed is removed; all other parts contain toxic taxine alkaloids.
